responsibility: Implements the GNU Modula-2 terminal-attribute wrapper around host `termios`, providing allocation and destruction of termios objects plus typed accessors for speed, control characters, and flag bits. It also exposes capability checks and setters for raw-mode and flow-control operations, translating Modula-2 enum values into the corresponding host terminal fields and constants.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of the Gtermios pair: it maps the termios_* API onto host termios structures, constants, and conditional feature support, including enum-to-bitfield/control-character translation, while gcc/m2/pge-boot/Gtermios.h defines the opaque type, enums, and exported signatures only.
